create_organization: create a new LiteLLM proxy organization with budget limits, model access, and optional object permissions
update_organization: update an existing LiteLLM proxy organization's budget, models, rate limits, or object permissions
delete_organization: delete one or more LiteLLM proxy organizations along with their teams, members, and keys
add_organization_member: add one or more users to a LiteLLM proxy organization with role and optional budget settings
update_organization_member: update a member's role or budget within a LiteLLM proxy organization
